description: This file contains a series of automated test cases for Android device browser functionalities using Playwright testing framework. It tests device properties, browser launching, page interactions, screenshot capture, CDP messaging, context options, and HAR recording.

methods.name: androidDevice.model
methods.description: Checks that the android device model contains expected substrings.

methods.name: androidDevice.launchBrowser
methods.description: Launches a browser on the android device with optional parameters.

methods.name: page.goto
methods.description: Navigates the page to a specified URL.

methods.name: page.title
methods.description: Retrieves the title of the current page.

methods.name: page.setContent
methods.description: Sets the HTML content of the page.

methods.name: page.evaluate
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code in the page context.

methods.name: page.screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the page.

methods.name: context.newCDPSession
methods.description: Creates a new Chrome DevTools Protocol session.

methods.name: client.send
methods.description: Sends commands over the CDP session.

methods.name: page.url
methods.description: Gets the current URL of the page.

ctags.name: fullPageScreenshot
ctags.pattern: /^  const fullPageScreenshot = await page.screenshot({ fullPage: true, scale: 'css' });$/

ctags.name: screenshot
ctags.pattern: /^  const screenshot = await page.screenshot({ fullPage: false, scale: 'css' });$/
